questions.text: How many days are in a leap year?
questions.explanation: A leap year adds 29 February, making 366 days.

questions.text: Which animal is traditionally called the "king of the jungle"?
questions.explanation: The lion is nicknamed the king of the jungle, though it lives on savannas.

questions.text: What is the chemical symbol for gold?
Which planet is known as the Red Planet?
questions.explanation: Iron oxide on its surface gives Mars its red colour.

questions.text: Which instrument has 88 keys on a standard modern model?
questions.explanation: A standard piano has 52 white and 36 black keys.

questions.text: Which Shakespeare play features the characters Rosencrantz and Guildenstern?
questions.explanation: They are Hamlet's old school friends, sent by the king to spy on him.

questions.text: Which is the longest river in Africa?
questions.explanation: The Nile is about 6,650 km long.

questions.text: Which French emperor was exiled to the island of Elba in 1814?
questions.explanation: Napoleon was sent to Elba after abdicating in April 1814.

questions.text: Which planet is best known for its bright, prominent rings?
questions.explanation: Saturn's ring system is the largest and brightest in the solar system.

questions.text: Which Danish physicist proposed a 1913 model of the atom with electrons in fixed orbits?
questions.explanation: Bohr's model explained the spectrum of hydrogen using quantised orbits.

questions.text: Which Russian composer wrote "The Rite of Spring"?
Which Irish author wrote the novel Ulysses, published in 1922?
questions.explanation: Joyce's Ulysses retells Homer's epic over one day in Dublin.

questions.text: Which mathematician proved Fermat's Last Theorem in the 1990s?
What is the deepest known point in Earth's oceans called?
questions.explanation: Challenger Deep in the Mariana Trench is about 11 km deep.

spares.text: Which bird is said in folklore to deliver newborn babies?
spares.explanation: The stork legend comes from European folklore.

spares.text: Which chemical element has the atomic number 1?
spares.explanation: Hydrogen has a single proton in its nucleus.

spares.text: Which ancient Greek mathematician wrote the geometry textbook Elements?
spares.explanation: Euclid's Elements organised geometry into proofs from axioms.
